# onpager_silence (Resource)

Manage one silence, including its complete team set, CEL expression and fixed time interval.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "onpager_team" "maintenance" {
  name = "Maintenance"
}

# One silence owns the complete team set, including multiteam declarations.
resource "onpager_silence" "maintenance" {
  scope      = "team"
  team_ids   = [onpager_team.maintenance.id]
  expression = "labels.environment == 'staging'"
  comment    = "Planned staging maintenance"
  starts_at  = "2027-01-10T10:00:00Z"
  ends_at    = "2027-01-10T11:00:00Z"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `ends_at` (String) Fixed exclusive end, local `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss` or RFC3339 with an explicit offset, at most six fractional digits. Must follow starts_at. Local input is interpreted in the provider request timezone; the backend rejects ambiguous/nonexistent local times. Changing an explicit provider timezone plans an update for local input.
- `expression` (String) Nonempty CEL predicate, at most 4096 UTF-8 bytes. Use canonical text without leading/trailing whitespace or NUL. The backend validates and compiles the expression.
- `scope` (String) Immutable scope: `team` or `tenant`. Changing it replaces the whole silence. Tenant scope affects the whole tenant and requires an empty team set.
- `starts_at` (String) Fixed inclusive start, local `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss` or RFC3339 with an explicit offset, at most six fractional digits. Must precede ends_at. Local input is sent unchanged for backend timezone/DST validation. No relative duration or current-time default is used. Equivalent configured instants retain their spelling in state.

### Optional

- `comment` (String) Canonical comment, at most 4096 UTF-8 bytes, without leading/trailing whitespace or NUL. Omission or null defaults to an empty string; explicit empty clears the saved comment.
- `team_ids` (Set of String) Complete set of canonical team UUIDs. Nonempty for team scope; empty for tenant scope (default). A multiteam silence is one shared UUID. Updates replace the full set and require update authority in every current team plus create authority for newly added active teams.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Stable nonzero canonical lowercase OnPager UUID.
- `request_timezone` (String) Explicit provider request timezone last applied to local datetime inputs. Null when the provider timezone is omitted or all inputs have explicit offsets. Changing the explicit provider timezone plans an update for local inputs; refresh alone preserves saved instants. The backend interprets local clocks and reports DST ambiguity or nonexistent times.
- `revision` (Number) This silence's own numeric revision, used in strong `If-Match` for update and DELETE. Stale writes report conflicts and retain state; concurrent changes are never overwritten automatically.
- `status` (String) Observed API status: `scheduled`, `active`, `expired` or `cancelled`. Expired and cancelled objects remain in state. Operational cancellation is terminal and cannot be undone through an update; explicitly replace the resource if a new silence is desired.

## Import

Import using the canonical silence UUID, including expired or cancelled
silences. A silence targeting multiple teams is one shared resource; team views
do not identify separate objects.

Use an `import` block:

```terraform
import {
  to = onpager_silence.maintenance
  id = "77777777-7777-4777-8777-777777777777"
}
```

Or use the CLI:

```shell
terraform import onpager_silence.maintenance 77777777-7777-4777-8777-777777777777
```

## Ownership and lifecycle

This resource owns one UUID, its immutable `scope` and complete `team_ids` set.
Changing scope replaces the silence. Team scope requires at least one team;
tenant scope requires an empty set and affects the whole tenant. Team-set
updates replace all targets atomically. Manage the UUID once rather than as
separate resources for each team. Adding teams requires active targets and
create authority in each new team.

Use trimmed UTF-8 expression and comment text; limits count bytes. Empty
comments clear saved text. The API compiles CEL and returns validation
diagnostics.

Expiry changes computed `status` while the silence remains managed and editable.
Cancellation is terminal: a cancelled silence remains readable, but updates
fail. Create another silence by explicitly replacing the resource, for example
`terraform apply -replace=onpager_silence.maintenance`. Cancelled configuration
is not restored or automatically replaced.

Update and DELETE use the silence's own strong numeric `If-Match`, independently
of capability and status projections. Conflicts require a new plan. A committed
write saves its identity and revision before a follow-up read. That read must
match the committed revision before local timestamp inputs can be bound; a
concurrent edit reports a conflict and retains the committed receipt.
Authentication, authorization, transport, conflict and malformed-response errors
retain state. Canonical GET distinguishes denied existing configuration (HTTP
403) from confirmed absence (HTTP 404).

Destroy deletes the UUID and all team links, including expired or cancelled
configuration and inactive linked teams when authorized. An empty HTTP 204 or an
authorized repeated missing DELETE confirms removal. Failure retains state;
cancellation is not used as a fallback. Admission snapshots and anonymous
historical suppression facts remain; the API redacts deleted configuration IDs,
links and dates. Deletion does not replay suppressed admissions.

## Fixed timestamps and timezone

Both endpoints are required finite timestamps with at most microsecond
precision. Use local `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss[.fraction]` values or RFC3339 with an
explicit offset. There is no relative duration or current-time default. Input is
sent unchanged; the API interprets local values in the request timezone,
validates DST transitions and checks endpoint ordering, including mixed local
and explicit-offset values. Explicit offsets identify absolute instants.

Private bindings preserve local strings while authoritative saved server
instants remain equivalent; changed instants appear as drift. Committed writes
invalidate old bindings before the follow-up read. Equivalent explicit-offset
input retains its configured spelling. Import adopts explicit-offset API values.
Input strings and private timestamp bindings persist in Terraform state.

Changing an explicit provider `timezone` plans an update through computed
`request_timezone` for local inputs. Apply reinterprets those strings in the new
zone; refresh preserves stored instants. Explicit-offset-only inputs do not
require a write for a request-zone change. Omitted timezone follows the API
actor's default without explicit zone tracking.

## Permissions

Personal tokens and service accounts require explicit native grants. Team scope
requires `silences.create`, `silences.read`, `silences.update` and
`silences.delete`; tenant scope requires `silences.global.create`,
`silences.global.read`, `silences.global.update` and `silences.global.delete`.

A write affecting multiple teams requires its action in every current team; new
teams also require create authority. Reading requires visibility in at least one
current team. Create and update require read authority for follow-up reads.
Delete authority is independent of read and cancel authority; cancel grants are
not used. Managing teams requires their separate grants.
